Definition: from G5228 and the alternate form of G1632; to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow:--run over.
BiblicalUsage: hyperekchýnō means run over. In Luke 6:38, the text says "and running over."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hyperekchýnō I do not force more than it gives: run over.
